files=sorted({p for p in (root/'crates/deadlib-lua').rglob('*')if p.suffix in {'.rs','.c','.h'}}|set(fixture.iterdir())|{root/'crates/deadlib-lua/Cargo.toml',root/'scripts/check_rust_lua_native_boundary.py',root/'Cargo.toml',root/'Cargo.lock',root/'.cargo/config.toml'})
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def hashes():return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix():sha(p)for p in files if p.is_file()}
before=hashes();linux='/home/perfecttaste/.cache/deadlua-native-context/1793130712142473700'
def run(name,cmd):
 start=time.monotonic();p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,capture_output=True);log=logs/(name+'.log');log.write_bytes(p.stdout+p.stderr)
 s=(p.stdout+p.stderr).decode(errors='replace');groups=[dict(passed=int(a),failed=int(b),ignored=int(c))for a,b,c in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored',s)]
 result=dict(name=name,command=cmd,returncode=p.returncode,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,log=str(log),log_sha256=sha(log),test_groups=groups,passed=sum(g['passed']for g in groups))
 print(name,p.returncode,result['passed'],flush=True)
 if p.returncode:print(s[-3500:],flush=True)
 return result
def suite(platform):
 cmds=[('tests',['cargo','test','--locked','-p','deadlib-lua','--no-fail-fast']),('no-default-features',['cargo','check','--locked','-p','deadlib-lua','--no-default-features','--all-targets']),('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--locked','-p','deadlib-lua','--all-targets','--no-deps','--','-D','warnings'])]
 if platform=='windows':
  cmds += [('fmt',['cargo','fmt','-p','deadlib-lua','--','--check']),('dependencies',['cargo','tree','--locked','-p','deadlib-lua','--edges','normal,build'])]
  return [run(platform+'-'+n,c[:2]+['--target-dir','target/lua-native-hooks']+c[2:] if n in ('tests','clippy','no-default-features') else c)for n,c in cmds]
 result=[]
 for name,cmd in cmds:
  env=['CARGO_TARGET_DIR='+linux+('/native'if platform=='linux-x64'else'/i686')]
  if platform=='linux-i686':
   cmd=cmd[:2]+['--target','i686-unknown-linux-gnu']+cmd[2:];env+=['CFLAGS_i686_unknown_linux_gnu=-msse2 -mfpmath=sse']
  shell='exec env '+' '.join(shlex.quote(x)for x in env+cmd)+' 2>&1'
  result.append(run(platform+'-'+name,['wsl.exe','-d','Debian','--cd',str(root),'--','sh','-lc',shell]))
 return result
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3)as pool:runs=[r for group in pool.map(suite,['windows','linux-x64','linux-i686'])for r in group]
result=dict(source_hashes=before,runs=runs,linux_target_root=linux,sources_unchanged=before==hashes())
(root/'docs/testing/2026-10-29-rust-lua-hook-stacks-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
